answer_1.quote: Table-to-text generation is an essential task for text generation from structured data.

answer_2.quote: We refer the readers to ... use BLEU and three extractive evaluation metrics, Relation Generation (RG), Content Selection (CS), and Content Ordering (CO) to evaluate the table-to-text results.

answer_4.quote: Three graduate students with basketball background knowledge and good English reading ability were invited to conduct the evaluation. ... participants were asked to choose which one is better according to five criteria: Supporting, Contradicting, Grammaticality, Coherence, and Conciseness.
answer_4.guideline: Participants compare pairs of summaries and select the better one based on five criteria: Supporting, Contradicting, Grammaticality, Coherence, Conciseness.
